boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain High Point University
boards.description: A practical mix of campus markets, HPU dining, and nearby High Point counters with directly documented service at 10 p.m. or later.

cards.title: Market @ Wanek After Hours
cards.subtitle: A 2 a.m. campus-market option in the R.G. Wanek Center
cards.notes: Bring your HPU Passport and check the live dining schedule before walking over, since academic-break hours can differ.
cards.short_summary: A campus market documented to remain available until 2 a.m. nightly during the academic schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU Dining’s 2026–2027 meal-plan FAQ states that The Market @ Wanek is open until 2 a.m. each night.
cards.access_notes: The university documents a 2 a.m. nightly closing; verify the live schedule during summer, holidays, and academic breaks. Campus access requires a valid HPU Passport from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m.

cards.title: Market @ Yadkin at 2 a.m.
cards.subtitle: Late provisions inside Yadkin Hall
cards.notes: Use this stop for packaged food or dorm necessities, and confirm the day’s listing before heading into Yadkin Hall.
cards.short_summary: Yadkin Hall’s named campus market extends HPU’s food access into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU Dining’s 2026–2027 meal-plan FAQ states that The Market @ Yadkin is open until 2 a.m. each night.
cards.access_notes: The university documents a 2 a.m. nightly closing; check live hours when classes are not in session. Campus access requires a valid HPU Passport from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m.

cards.title: The Point Before Midnight
cards.subtitle: A late campus grill in the R.G. Wanek Center
cards.notes: Check the current menu, order before the posted cutoff, and keep your HPU Passport ready for entry after 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A sit-down campus grill documented as an every-evening option through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU Dining’s 2026–2027 meal-plan FAQ says The Point is available until midnight each evening.
cards.access_notes: HPU documents availability until midnight each evening; summer and break schedules may vary. A valid HPU Passport is required for campus access after 10 p.m.

cards.title: Wendy’s Until 2 a.m.
cards.subtitle: A North Main Street drive-thru and dining room
cards.notes: Choose dine-in or drive-thru, confirm mobile availability, and arrange a safe ride rather than walking from campus late.
cards.short_summary: A nearby North Main Street counter with the same documented 2 a.m. close every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m.–2 a.m. daily at 2001 N Main Street.
cards.source_title: Wendy's N. Main St. in High Point, NC
cards.access_notes: Official hours list both the restaurant and drive-thru open until 2 a.m. Monday through Sunday; verify holiday exceptions before departure.

cards.title: Eastchester Drive at 3 a.m.
cards.subtitle: A late drive-thru northwest of campus
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru after the dining room closes, verify ordering availability, and plan transportation before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: The Eastchester location provides a documented drive-thru window extending to 3 a.m. nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–3 a.m. every day at 205 Eastchester Drive.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in High Point, NC — 205 Eastchester Dr
cards.access_notes: The drive-thru is officially listed until 3 a.m. daily, while the displayed dine-in closing is 10 p.m.; late service therefore requires a vehicle.

cards.title: South Main’s Weekend Extension
cards.subtitle: A drive-thru open later on Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Reserve this farther run for a planned drive, check the day-specific cutoff, and do not assume the dining room stays open late.
cards.short_summary: A South Main drive-thru with 2 a.m. weekday service and a later weekend schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 2701 South Main Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in High Point, NC — 2701 S Main St
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours run until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the displayed dine-in closing is 10 p.m.

cards.title: Saturday Runs Around the Clock
cards.subtitle: A seated late-night option near North Main Street
cards.notes: Check the weekday schedule before leaving: the all-night window is Saturday, while Friday service ends at midnight.
cards.short_summary: This High Point dining room offers a documented 24-hour Saturday alongside later Friday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official location page lists a midnight Friday close and 24-hour operation on Saturday at 110 East Parris Avenue.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast Restaurant at 110 E Parris Ave
cards.access_notes: Friday closes at midnight and Saturday is listed open 24 hours; Monday–Thursday and Sunday close at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Mall Loop Before Midnight
cards.subtitle: A late Friday-and-Saturday drive-thru
cards.notes: Target Friday or Saturday for the midnight window, order ahead when available, and confirm the store status before driving.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-focused run with both lobby and drive-thru documented through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists its lobby and drive-thru at 930 Mall Loop Road until midnight Friday and Saturday and 11 p.m. other nights.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 930 Mall Loop Rd, High Point, NC
cards.access_notes: Lobby and drive-thru close at midnight Friday–Saturday and 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday according to the official store schedule.

cards.title: Kirkwood Pizza Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: A takeout and delivery counter close to North Main Street
cards.notes: Start the order online before the cutoff, confirm delivery coverage to your building, or arrange transportation for pickup.
cards.short_summary: A named Kirkwood Street pizza counter whose official city listing documents midnight service.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official High Point location listing identifies the 2205 Kirkwood Street store and shows it open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Domino's in High Point, North Carolina
cards.access_notes: The official city listing displayed a midnight close when fetched; because it is a day-sensitive status, reconfirm the selected date before ordering.

cards.title: South Main’s Overnight Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour drive-thru on selected nights
cards.notes: Use a vehicle for overnight service, check the day-specific schedule, and note that lobby hours end before the drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A farther South Main option with documented overnight drive-thru service Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists the 2738 South Main Street drive-thru as open 24 hours Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 2738 S Main St, High Point, NC
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru service is listed for 24 hours Thursday–Saturday; lobby hours end at midnight on those nights, and other days have earlier cutoffs.
